name: StreamScapeTV repository-owned CI contract
summary: Central selects one fixed repository entrypoint on a bounded host OS and supplies only reviewed infrastructure plus a versioned structured semantic input document. Product commands and toolchain behavior stay in the repository.

scriptEnvironment.CI_HOST_OS: Selected host execution OS: linux or macos.
scriptEnvironment.CI_OPERATION: Selected fixed semantic operation: build, test, full, ui-test, or separately authorized release.
scriptEnvironment.CI_INPUTS_JSON: Canonical JSON object with schemaVersion=1 and an inputs object validated against the operation schema.
scriptEnvironment.CI_ARTIFACT_DIR: Central-owned optional bounded artifact evidence directory.

adoptionSteps: Add tracked executable fixed entrypoints under .ci/; unsupported operations must fail closed explicitly.
Read CI_HOST_OS and CI_INPUTS_JSON when product target, selectors, UI mode, or release identity are needed.
Validate and translate reviewed semantics inside the repository before invoking Xcode, Gradle, Python, Node, Flutter, or other product commands.
Do not upload evidence or request Drive, registry, runner, or secret configuration from the caller.

Request private infrastructure authorization through the project's trusted private Agent State configuration; public Central changes only when a new generic capability type or shared mechanism is required.

capabilityTypes.private_network: Connect the reviewed private network boundary before product execution.
capabilityTypes.github_git: Configure ephemeral Git HTTPS credentials for github.com using the Central source App token.
capabilityTypes.registry_netrc: Configure ephemeral HTTPS .netrc credentials for the approved private package registry host.
capabilityTypes.gradle_maven: Configure ephemeral Gradle properties centralRegistryUsername and centralRegistryReadToken for a repository that consumes a private Maven registry.

fields.repository: Exact repository identity bound privately to the requesting Agent State project.
fields.capabilities: Unique subset of the public generic capabilityTypes keys.

migrationLedger.retirementRule: A legacy profile lane may be removed only when the private ledger has no remaining live consumer for that lane.
